items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs and harvest the orange bulbs.

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town bounty board in The Last Resort saloon, then eliminate the assigned Outlaw.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from wild locations or plant vegetables at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Look for infestations on the map and eliminate Phantoms in the marked area.

items.title: Kill a Wendigo
items.detail: Fast travel to Vault 51 and eliminate the Wendigo in the Atrium area.

items.title: Sell Glowing Fungus Soup to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Craft at a cooking station using glowing fungus, boiled water, and wood.

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to another player's C.A.M.P. and enter their Shelter.

items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use a Company Tea generator or craft tea, then drink it.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine for a reliable spawn location.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: Join or create a team, enter Daily Ops, and eliminate Phantoms.

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Fast travel to Dino Peaks Mini Golf where three spawn reliably.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night at Rapidan Camp, then wait for Phantom to spawn in Vertibot area.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft or scrap items containing Aluminum at a workbench.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Scrap Abraxo cleaner, industrial solvent, turpentine, or tick blood sacs.

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Defeat a Mirelurk Queen at Mac's Farm or Spruce Knob Lake, cook steak, sell it.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint on foot without fast traveling; cover 50 km total.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six daily challenges on three separate days this week.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community building contest with themes inspired by classic slasher movies; submit builds for a chance to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Pint-Sized Phantoms and exclusive rewards tied to the Slasher theme.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Weekend event offering increased mutation spawns and enhanced rewards from Daily Operations.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring themed Scorched variants with new cosmetic and gameplay rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Weekend event doubling experience point gains from all activities.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Fishing event with increased chances to catch seasonal fish species.
